title: Spec 011 T141 readiness and governed delegation canary contract

phases.objective: Prove that the remaining live delegation lifecycle can be bound to migration, deployment, runtime, per-mutation authorization, receipt, readback, and unknown-outcome contracts without performing any staging or Production mutation during certification.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: buildT141CanaryContract with verified migration readiness, exact deployment readback, certified default-off runtime binding status, four eligible lifecycle plans, and four exact-fingerprint authorization bindings
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The contract is ready for a separately authorized staging or Production canary only when all readiness, deployment, lifecycle, authorization, receipt, and no-retry invariants pass; synthetic certification never closes T141 or performs a mutation.
steps: Evaluate staging or Production readiness and reject disposable databases, missing migration ledger evidence, checksum drift, runtime binding drift, deployment SHA mismatch, unhealthy runtime, or missing environment authority.
Validate four eligible lifecycle plans for primary create/revoke and expiry create/expire with distinct request fingerprints, pending receipts, and idempotency keys.
Bind every mutation to a distinct unexpired capability envelope and approval hold whose expected request fingerprint and environment match exactly.
Build the immutable ten-step canary order with same-cycle readback after every step and retry forbidden after any unknown outcome.
Evaluate synthetic successful staging evidence and prove that T141, T261, and T263 remain ineligible for closure.
Evaluate synthetic Production evidence and allow completion eligibility only when Production migration authorization, parity, runtime readback, all grant states, and all receipts are verified.
Inject timeout-after-dispatch, stale authorization, duplicate fingerprint, missing same-cycle readback, and secret-like input and prove fail-closed or reconciliation-required outcomes.
assertions: Readiness and contract construction perform no migration apply, database write, grant mutation, provider call, deployment, public-route addition, or runtime authority activation.
A staging canary can never make T141, T261, or T263 completion-eligible.
Production completion eligibility requires explicit Production migration authorization plus exact deployment and runtime parity.
Every mutation has a unique request fingerprint, pending receipt, idempotency key, capability envelope, and approval hold.
Unknown, ambiguous, or timeout-after-dispatch outcomes return reconciliation_required and automatic_mutation_retry_allowed=false.
runtime_policy_ready remains unpromoted and no public route is added.
The certification artifact states that no live canary ran and no Production authorization was used.

phases.objective: Execute the same contract against an explicitly authorized staging database and deployed runtime while persisting bounded receipts and exact readback evidence.
Prove read-only reconciliation after ambiguous commit outcomes, runtime restarts, stale envelopes, partial receipt readback, and deployment drift without repeated mutation.
Complete one governed staging create-inspect-revoke and create-inspect-expire lifecycle with every receipt reconciled and T141 still open.
Complete the separately authorized Production migration and delegation canary on one exact deployed SHA, then open the evidence-only closeout PR for T141, T261, T263, and T264.
